snippet.title: Darfall - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
Play Darfall now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1961600/Darfall/

Darfall is a hero-based RPG colony-building game that puts you in the role of a hero who must protect their home and help it develop! During the day, grow your hero’s might, find epic loot, master new abilities, and fortify your settlement. At night, survive the hordes of undead, until you triumph.
